source.title: Applications for WCA Continental Championships 2024
source.content:
Dear WCA Staff & Regional Organizations,

The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for **WCA Continental Championships 2024** for the following regions:

* Asia
* Europe
* North America
* South America

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition. **Please note that applications for continental championships must be endorsed by [WCA Recognized Regional Organizations](https://wca.link/organizations).**

If you are interested, send your application documents **privately to board@worldcubeassociation.org before May 31st, 2022, 23:59UTC. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions**: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.
<!-- break -->

Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

1. When would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2024?
    1. Possible dates
    2. Number of days of the competition.
    3. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.
2. Where would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2024 in your country?
    1. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing.
    2. Ease of international, national, and local travel.
    3. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories.
    4. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms).
    5. Technology available like the internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment.
    6. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.
3. What would the organization team and staff look like?
    1. Core team members.
    2. Experience of the core team.
    3. Involvement of other parties.
    4. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff).
    5. Required support by foreign Delegates.
4. What would be the overall budget for the competition?
    1. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/gift packs, prizes).
    2. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where each 2024 Continental Championship will take place. If any Director will be involved in a team that sends in an application, they will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for a competition that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and being able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you for your cooperation in advance!

Note: Applications for Africa & Oceania will open later in the year.

translation.title: 开放申办 2024 年 WCA 大洲锦标赛
translation.content:
各位 WCA 工作人员及地区组织成员：

董事会现征集以下地区的 **2024 年 WCA 大洲锦标赛**申办材料：

* 亚洲
* 欧洲
* 北美洲
* 南美洲

请与本国代表讨论，你们是否有意愿和能力承办。请注意，举办这一规模的比赛，在赛前和比赛期间都需要投入大量时间和精力。**各大洲锦标赛的申办必须得到 [WCA 认可的地区组织](https://wca.link/organizations)支持。**

如有意申办，请于 **2022 年 5 月 31 日 23:59 UTC 前，将申请材料私下发送至 board@worldcubeassociation.org。材料须为 PDF 格式，并提供两个版本**：一份包含所有申办细节的完整版；另一份去除敏感信息（如有），用于公开。

申办材料至少应包含以下信息：

1. 你们希望何时举办 2024 年大洲锦标赛？
   1. 可选日期。
   2. 比赛天数。
   3. 与各国学校假期的重合情况。
2. 你们希望在本国的哪个地点举办？
   1. 城市应对海外访客有吸引力，并有观光游览的机会。
   2. 国际、国内及市内交通的便利程度。
   3. 是否有不同价位的酒店或公寓可供选择。
   4. 场地、面积及布置，包括赛台、观众区、练习桌和附属房间。
   5. 可用的技术设施，如网络、视频直播、灯光及音响设备。
   6. 可容纳的选手和观众人数。
3. 主办团队和工作人员如何安排？
   1. 核心团队成员。
   2. 核心团队的经验。
   3. 其他合作方的参与情况。
   4. 当地志愿者的数量与能力；建议有 20% 的选手担任工作人员。
   5. 需要海外代表提供哪些支持。
4. 比赛总体预算是多少？
   1. 支出：场地、场地服务、赛台、器材、装饰、网站、证件/挂绳/礼包、奖品等。
   2. 收入：报名费、赞助、地方政府支持等。

以下示例表格列出了大型比赛需要安排和编列预算的部分事项，并非完整清单：https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8

申办期结束后，WCA 董事会将与申请方面谈，咨询其他 WCA 工作人员，并投票决定各场 2024 年大洲锦标赛的举办地。如果某位董事参与了申办团队，该董事在遴选流程中的职责将由他人代替，例如高级代表或委员会、团队负责人。

我们期待通过这些比赛进一步完善大型 WCA 赛事的办赛理念，让协会工作更专业，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也向全世界呈现尽可能精彩的比赛。

提前感谢大家的配合！

注：非洲和大洋洲锦标赛将在今年晚些时候开放申办。
